title: So far looks great!
body: Colours and descriptions match my brain!
author: Fttxi

title: Stopped my procrastination
body: I love the minimalistic style of this app and the notes as well as the ability to sort the tasks based on dates, priorities etc. is amazing. I only have the free tier but it includes all of this which is more than enough. There’s also great syncing between laptop and phone and in general it’s a great app.
author: Notab123

title: Amazing.
body: Must-have for note taking, but it does much more than that. Congratulations on the official app launch guys, I’ve been on TestFlight for a while now.
author: drago46

title: Finally found an app for my brain !
body: I have a number of ADHD neuro tendancies and yep this app has enaged me instanteously.  Ive used all of the so called to-do apps but this one really suits me.  So many nifty features.  Thanks for building this, looking forward to many years of use.
author: briefDots
